text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: Papaaa! The show's about to start!

text_block_list.name: Child's Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thanks for letting me know! Uhh... the 
Derby special is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Japanese Derby— A dream treasure 
coveted by all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, there is nothing she cannot steal! 
Phantom Thief Gold Ship makes her 
entrance!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gehehehe... I'll be taking this...! My 
beloved Derby-chan...♪
(Honk! Honk!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's with this sound?! It hasn't even 
been three minutes yet?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Who're you callin' impatient, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"I...! At the Derby, the dream stage for 
horse girls...!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "I will definitely catch Gold Ship-san!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno gains momentum from the Aoba Sho! 
How will the clash with Gold Ship unfold?!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Fufu. The Golshi this time 
around is a bad girl~.

text_block_list.name: Child's Father
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, yeah, true. Fenomeno might just 
catch ya~.

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
To that scary-looking Umamusume? Huh~~? 
Ehehehe~!
"CASE: Motive"

—The day of the 'Japanese Derby', Tokyo 
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(—The surging cheers reach all the way out 
here.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(The scents in this place are far too 
mixed. Excitement and expectation, anxiety 
and impatience——)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(The scent is so strong... I can't even 
tell who it belongs to.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"In this Japan Derby, there is only one 
directive the competing Umamusume must 
fulfill."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Boss. Please, give me my orders as well.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Gasp!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: There you are, Mame-chin. Huh...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's get this doggy battle started!! 
Woof, bow-wow!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wha—Golshi-san...! Even at the Derby, 
you...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Bwahaha! That's suuuuper scary!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, it's so scary I'm turning into pure 
cosmic space, woof~.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
T-This officer... has never done a 
spacewalk before—! 
...B-BOOOOOOOSSSSSSSSS!!
(Beep!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Did you seriously think we were 
in outer space?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"You thought it was just regular 
projection mapping~!? Pukuku, pupipoo! 
Woof woof wooof!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I wiill nooot fooorgiiive thiiis!! Setting 
up your own contraptions in everyone's 
precious paddock is absolutely outrageous!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you toy with me in front of 
everyone any longer! Brace yourself, 
Golshi-san!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I won't give up the title of Derby 
Umamusume to someone like you!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: ...*giggle*. Fenomeno, do your best!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa, whoa, whoa, Mame-chin. No 
looking away, alright~? We're on the money 
shot here."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Keep looking this way. Come on—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —How about I make another move?
